note: Each slot is one area theme. The game plays its built-in band score unless you load your own audio file for a slot from the in-game menu. The lyrics and style text are written for this game and are free to use for making sung versions.

slots.title: Ember Road
slots.style: Anthemic alternative pop-rock, 96 BPM, A minor. Half-time stomping drums and hand claps, pulsing piano, deep bass, huge 'whoa-oh' gang vocals in the chorus, raspy male lead vocal, big arena reverb. Starts small and explodes at the chorus.
slots.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Woke up to ashes on the windowsill,
The bells are silent and the vale is still,
Got a borrowed blade and a hood of gold,
And a promise made to the ones I hold.

[Pre-Chorus]
So I'll walk till the morning breaks,
Every step that the long road takes...

[Chorus]
Whoa-oh, light the road, light the road ahead,
Through the thorn and the stone where the brave have tread,
Whoa-oh, I will carry home the fire we lost,
No matter the miles, no matter the frost.

[Verse 2]
Slimes in the meadow and the crows on the wire,
Every shadow tells me leave it, let it expire,
But I hear my grandmother's voice in the pines:
"Little light, little light, you were born to shine."

[Bridge]
And if I fall, I'll rise again,
Hearts in my hand like a lantern flame...

[Chorus]

slots.title: Hold the Line
slots.style: Dark cinematic alt-rock, 76 BPM, D minor. Slow tribal floor toms, low piano, droning bass and strings, hushed lead vocal, distant choir hums. Tense and echoing, like walking through a flooded castle.
slots.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
In the halls where the old stones weep,
Something's breathing in the Sunken Keep,
Every torch is a heartbeat low,
Every echo whispers "turn back, go."

[Chorus]
Hold the line, hold the line,
Don't let the dark get inside,
Iron heart and steady eyes,
I'll walk where the brambles hide.

[Verse 2]
Water rising on the broken stair,
Skeletons dancing on the midnight air,
I keep a small key close to my chest,
I'll sleep when the Ember's back in its nest.

[Chorus]

slots.title: Into the Blue
slots.style: Atmospheric alt-pop, 84 BPM, E minor. Dripping plucked arpeggios with echo, deep toms, airy pads, breathy lead vocal that opens into a soaring 'ahh' choir. Underwater, mysterious, hopeful.
slots.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Salt on my lips and the tide coming in,
The cave sings low where the drowned have been,
A pearl in the deep like a moon underground,
It's calling my name without making a sound.

[Chorus]
Dive, dive, into the blue,
There's a light in the depths and it's pulling me through,
Rise, rise, out of the wave,
I'll carry it home from the grotto's grave.

[Bridge]
Ahh... ahh...
Old Shellback's waiting where the currents turn,
Every scar's a lesson that I had to learn.

[Chorus]

slots.title: Stand Your Ground
slots.style: Driving arena rock, 132 BPM, E minor. Pounding drums, distorted guitar chugs, gritty bass, shouted 'Hey!' gang vocals, defiant belted chorus. Pure battle energy.
slots.lyrics:
[Intro]
Hey! Hey!

[Verse]
Feel the floor begin to tremble,
Feel the walls begin to crumble,
I was small but I'm not running,
I can hear the giant coming.

[Chorus]
Stand your ground, stand your ground, let it roar,
I've been knocked down, I've been here before,
Stand your ground, raise the blade, make it fall,
One heart, one hope, against it all!

[Outro]
Hey! Hey!

slots.title: Willowmere
slots.style: Gentle folk-pop lullaby, 72 BPM, C major. Soft piano arpeggios, warm pads, a light heartbeat kick, tender lead vocal with hummed harmonies.
slots.lyrics:
[Verse]
Lanterns on the water, smoke above the pines,
Grandmother's stories of the better times,
Close your eyes, little light,
Morning's coming after night.

[Chorus]
Mmm, Willowmere, Willowmere,
Every road leads back to here,
When you're lost and far from home,
Follow the lanterns, you're not alone.

slots.title: Home Again
slots.style: Triumphant stadium anthem, 100 BPM, C major. Big stomp-clap drums, bright piano, full 'whoa-oh' choir chorus, celebratory and emotional.
slots.lyrics:
[Verse]
Ring the bells and ring them loud,
Lift the lanterns to the clouds,
We were lost, but now we're found,
Hear the vale come back around.

[Chorus]
Whoa-oh, we're home again,
The fire's lit, the tide's come in,
Whoa-oh, the night is done,
Wren brought the morning sun!
